chapters.title: Hook
lines: Your laptop's across the room. Your phone is in your hand.
This is Edgepad five. Free, open source, and it turns your phone into the trackpad, keyboard, gamepad and remote for your laptop.

chapters.title: The surface
lines: A multi-touch trackpad, with dials on every corner. Volume, brightness, zoom, scrubbing.
Change the volume on the laptop, and the dial follows.

chapters.title: Controls
lines: A keyboard in six sizes. A gamepad your games see as a real Xbox controller, on Windows and Linux.
A presenter with a laser. Screenshots and recordings, sent to your phone.
Clipboard sync and file sending, both ways. Macros that run from a shape you draw.
Air mouse: tilt to aim, hold a button to drag.
And for developers: your AI limits, sessions and pull requests, at a glance.

chapters.title: Everywhere
lines: Windows, Mac and Linux. Bluetooth, Wi-Fi or USB. No account, no server.
Mac and Linux are newer, so tell us on GitHub when something's off.

chapters.title: Next
lines: Screen mirroring and remote access are coming in Edgepad six.

chapters.title: Get it
lines: Edgepad. Free and open source, on GitHub.
Your laptop, from anywhere in the room.
